   - Use 1 oak fence to craft 1 stick.

4. **Craft Armor Stand**:

   - Use 6 sticks to craft 1 armor stand.

7. Use 6 sticks to craft 1 armor stand.

This sequence ensures that we gather all necessary materials and craft the armor stand successfully.
